name: model-hint
description: Suggests haiku, sonnet or opus for the task you are typing, live, in a band above the prompt. Instant word rules, then a small model reads the draft when you pause.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: model: word rules answer instantly, then a small model reads the draft after a short pause (one tiny completion per pause). rules: words only, no model calls.

judge.title: Judge model
judge.description: Alias or id of the model that reads the draft, when engine is model.

show.title: When to show the hint
show.description: when-different: only when the suggested tier is not the one you are on. always: for every draft.

bias.title: Bias
bias.description: cost leans toward cheaper tiers, quality toward stronger ones, balanced sits between.
